security.item: Article data (Open Graph texts, images, publish date) is only read on single article views of com_content, and only for published articles the visitor is allowed to see. Before, any "id" in the URL loaded the article with that id, including unpublished or access-restricted ones.
og:url no longer contains the query string of the request.
Image paths are resolved inside the site root only.

fix.item: Existing Open Graph data set by other extensions is no longer overwritten (PR #14).
Product price and currency (og_type "product") are now written to the page; the plugin read the wrong setting names before.
article:published_time is now ISO 8601 and uses the publish date of the article.
No PHP warning any more when a request has no User-Agent header.
Category pages no longer show the image of an unrelated article with the same id.
Removed stray example meta lines from the forms and the manifest.
Help text no longer links to the X Card Validator, which X shut down.
Pinterest help text no longer links to the Rich Pin Validator, which Pinterest shut down. Rich Pins work without validation now.
When another extension already set og:image, the plugin no longer adds image type and size of a different image.

addition.item: The general image (og_image) is now the last fallback for every visitor: pages without a Facebook image and without an article image still get an og:image. Before, it was only used for Google.
New plugin option "Priority of the settings": menu item before article (default, as before) or article before menu item.

change.item: Twitter is now called X (Twitter) in all labels and help texts. The meta tags stay twitter:*, as X still reads them under this name.
og:image:width and og:image:height are now written as property, like the other Open Graph tags.
Ready for Joomla 5 and Joomla 6: no longer relies on the deprecated plugin property injection, $app->input and Factory::getConfig().
Update server offers this version to Joomla 4, 5 and 6 (beta channel).
